name: AR_LC_CUST_SITES_T
description: Table which stores the eligible customers for late charge processing

columns.name: LC_CUST_SITES_ID
columns.description: The primary column for this table

columns.name: CUSTOMER_ID
columns.description: The Customer Identifier

columns.name: CUSTOMER_SITE_USE_ID
columns.description: The Customer Site Use Identifier for the Bill To Site

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency Code

columns.name: CUSTOMER_PROFILE_ID
columns.description: The Customer Profile Identifier

columns.name: COLLECTOR_ID
columns.description: The Collector Identifier

columns.name: LATE_CHARGE_CALCULATION_TRX
columns.description: Eligibility criteria to select transactions for late charge processing

columns.name: CREDIT_ITEMS_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether credit items are considered for late charge processing

columns.name: DISPUTED_TRANSACTIONS_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether disputed transactions are considered for late charge processing

columns.name: PAYMENT_GRACE_DAYS
columns.description: Maximum number of overdue days allowed before action is taken

columns.name: LATE_CHARGE_TYPE
columns.description: Document that will be created by the late charges program

columns.name: LATE_CHARGE_TERM_ID
columns.description: Payment Term Identifier used for creating Interest Invoice or Debit Memo

columns.name: INTEREST_PERIOD_DAYS
columns.description: Days in interest period

columns.name: INTEREST_CALCULATION_PERIOD
columns.description: Indicates whether the interest calculation is Daily or Monthly

columns.name: CHARGE_ON_FINANCE_CHARGE_FLAG
columns.description: Formula used for interest calculation. Simple(N), Compound(Y) and Flat(F)

columns.name: HOLD_CHARGED_INVOICES_FLAG
columns.description: Place a hold on charged invoices

columns.name: MESSAGE_TEXT_ID
columns.description: Message text field identifier that allows messages to print on late charge invoices and debit memos. This is a foreign key to AR_STANDARD_TEXT.STANDARD_TEXT_ID.

columns.name: MULTIPLE_INTEREST_RATES_FLAG
columns.description: Use Multiple Interest Rates for interest calculation

columns.name: CHARGE_BEGIN_DATE
columns.description: Date from which the late charge set up is effective

columns.name: CONS_INV_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether Balance Forward Billing is enabled

columns.name: CONS_BILL_LEVEL
columns.description: Balance forward bill level. Can either  the customer account or customer site.

columns.name: LAST_CONS_BILL_ID
columns.description: Balance Forward Bill Identifier for the last bill.

columns.name: LAST_CONS_BILL_AMOUNT
columns.description: Last Balance Forward Bill amount

columns.name: LAST_CONS_BILL_DATE
columns.description: Last Balance Forward Bill date

columns.name: LAST_CONS_BILL_DUE_DATE
columns.description: Last Balance Forward Bill due date

columns.name: CUST_ACCT_PROFILE_AMT_ID
columns.description: Customer Account Profile Amount Identifier

columns.name: EXCHANGE_RATE
columns.description: Conversion rate.

columns.name: EXCHANGE_RATE_TYPE
columns.description: Conversion rate type.

columns.name: MIN_FC_INVOICE_OVERDUE_TYPE
columns.description: Minimum Invoice amount overdue type.

columns.name: MIN_FC_INVOICE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Invoice balance threshold amount below which late charges must not be charged

columns.name: MIN_FC_INVOICE_PERCENT
columns.description: Invoice balance threshold percentage below which late charges must not be charged

columns.name: MIN_FC_BALANCE_OVERDUE_TYPE
columns.description: Minimum customer balance overdue type

columns.name: MIN_FC_BALANCE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Customer balance threshold amount below which the late charge must not be charged

columns.name: MIN_FC_BALANCE_PERCENT
columns.description: Customer balance percentage threshold below which the late charge must not be charged

columns.name: MIN_INTEREST_CHARGE
columns.description: Threshold amount below  which the late charge must not charged

columns.name: MAX_INTEREST_CHARGE
columns.description: Threshold amount which limits the late charge amount

columns.name: INTEREST_TYPE
columns.description: Indicates fixed amount, percent, charges schedule based interest

columns.name: INTEREST_RATE
columns.description: Interest Rate for fixed percentage set up

columns.name: INTEREST_FIXED_AMOUNT
columns.description: Interest for fixed amount set up

columns.name: INTEREST_SCHEDULE_ID
columns.description: Charge Schedule Identifier for Interest rate

columns.name: PENALTY_TYPE
columns.description: Indicates fixed amount, percent, charges schedule based penalty

columns.name: PENALTY_RATE
columns.description: Penalty Rate for fixed percentage set up

columns.name: PENALTY_FIXED_AMOUNT
columns.description: Penalty for fixed amount set up

columns.name: PENALTY_SCHEDULE_ID
columns.description: Charge Schedule Identifier for Penalty rate

columns.name: LAST_ACCRUE_CHARGE_DATE
columns.description: Late date on which late charge was calculated for this site

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.
